podcast.title: Innovative Use of Auto-Tune (2008)
podcast.body: T-Pain's "innovative use of auto to me was vital to the evolution of hip hop and pop" by 2008, demonstrating his commanding influence in securing an instant number one for new rapper Flo Rida on their collaboration "Low." "T.P. with his innovative use of auto to me was vital to the evolution of hip hop and pop and it's a sign of how commanding he was by 2008 that his featured role on this jam could get new rapper flow rider an instant number one."

podcast.title: Most Viewed Tiny Desk and Format Shift
podcast.body: T-Pain's Tiny Desk video became the most viewed in the channel's history and served as a major turning point. The format's creators took note and subsequently opened their doors to all genres and styles, abandoning their initial focus on indie music. "El vídeo se volvió viral, cayó muchas vocales y se convirtió en el Ténidé es más vista de la historia del canal."

podcast.title: Pioneer of Exaggerated Auto-Tune Use
podcast.body: T-Pain is cited as an artist who "really went to town with auto-tune," employing the software for pronounced, stylistic vocal effects that extended beyond simple pitch correction. His widespread and distinctive use of Auto-Tune played a crucial role in popularizing its exaggerated application in mainstream music. "Kanye, T-Pain, Travis Scott, and many others really went to town with auto-tune."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 100 Greatest Rock Moments of the Millennium So Far - Part 5: (60-51)

podcast.title: Tiny Desk Performance - Autotune-Free Surprise
podcast.body: T-Pain, known globally for his iconic use of Autotune, surprised audiences during his Tiny Desk performance by delivering a show without effects. He demonstrated a vocal range and sensibility that was captivating, and the video went viral, attracting many new viewers. "En aquel directo, el rapero sorprendió por hacer un show sin efectos, mostrando un rango vocal y una sensibilidad que era disparada."

xref.title: Pioneer of Exaggerated Auto-Tune Use
xref.body: Kanye is recognized as one of the artists who "really went to town with auto-tune," utilizing the technology not just for subtle pitch correction but for highly exaggerated and distinct vocal effects. His influential work contributed significantly to the trend of Auto-Tune being used as a deliberate stylistic choice in popular music. "Kanye, T-Pain, Travis Scott, and many others really went to town with auto-tune."

xref.title: Pioneer of Exaggerated Auto-Tune Use
xref.body: Travis Scott is listed among the artists who "really went to town with auto-tune," leveraging the technology to create highly exaggerated and unique vocal sounds. His work exemplifies the trend of using Auto-Tune as a creative effect rather than solely for pitch correction, shaping its perception in contemporary music. "Kanye, T-Pain, Travis Scott, and many others really went to town with auto-tune."
